wireContract: Song stems, phase one: song upload reservations accept slot primary_audio, instrumental_audio or vocal_audio; POST /media-post-submissions/{submission_id}/stems seals an uploaded instrumental or vocals stem onto the author's unpublished song submission; song submission snapshots carry an optional stems field (instrumental_audio and vocal_audio, each sealed or null). Existing operations are unchanged; a primary reservation remains the only way to create a submission.

remaining: Repository check and unit, Node and Workerd tests
